provider.scriptInactiveHint: This provider has a proxy script enabled, but local routing is off for this app, so requests bypass the script.
provider.proxyScriptToggleHint: Enable or disable this provider's proxy script without opening the editor; the code is kept. Enabling the current provider's script turns on local routing.
provider.proxyScriptEnabledDesktopUpgraded: Proxy script enabled; provider switched to local routing

claudeDesktop.modelMappingOffHint: Direct mode works only when the provider accepts Claude Desktop's three role IDs (claude-sonnet-* / claude-opus-* / claude-haiku-*); for any other model name (including legacy IDs like claude-3-5-sonnet-…) or when you need a proxy script, select Local Routing.
claudeDesktop.modelMappingOnHint: Claude Desktop only accepts the three role IDs claude-sonnet-* / claude-opus-* / claude-haiku-*. In Local Routing mode, Claude Desktop connects to the CC Switch routing service, which maps these roles to your provider's actual models; proxy scripts only run in this mode.
claudeDesktop.savedRestartRequired: Saved. Restart Claude Desktop to apply.

dbUpgrade.description: This database is newer than the version supported by this build and cannot be opened.
dbUpgrade.updateAvailable: Version v{{version}} is available. Try updating the application.
dbUpgrade.incompatibleDescription: Back up the current configuration directory first. Then rebuild this project from source that supports the database version, or quit the app and restore a database backup compatible with this build.

takeover.scriptConfirmMessage: The current provider "{{provider}}" has a proxy script enabled. After disabling local routing for {{app}}, requests go straight to the upstream and the script no longer runs.

desktop.hint: Claude Desktop has no separate switch: it goes through the routing service whenever the current provider's access mode is Local Routing. Change it in the provider editor.

eventLog.title: Detailed Request Logs
eventLog.description: Set how much of each request and response body to store and how long to retain logs.
eventLog.bodyLimitDescription: Each direction is limited to 0–{{max}} KiB. Set to 0 to record metadata only.
eventLog.purgeDaysDescription: Keep logs for 1–{{max}} days. Expired logs are removed at app startup and daily while running.
eventLog.effectiveHint: The body limit applies to new requests. Retention changes apply at the next cleanup. No proxy restart is required.
eventLog.invalidBodyLimit: The body limit must be a whole number from 0 to {{max}} (KiB).
eventLog.invalidPurgeDays: Retention must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}} days.
eventLog.saveFailed: Failed to save detailed request log settings: {{error}}
eventLog.loadFailed: Failed to load detailed request log settings

detail.notFound: Record not found or already purged
detail.delta: Only the difference from the original request was stored; the merged effective body is shown below
detail.unavailable: Cannot reconstruct, showing the raw record

network.label: Install and update network
network.hint: Use app proxy applies the global outbound proxy in Settings. Without one, environment and npm settings are inherited. Direct connection bypasses proxies. Applies only to install/update subprocesses for this session. WSL uses the same address; ensure the proxy is reachable from WSL.

proxyScript.title: Provider proxy script
proxyScript.description: Enter single-file TypeScript middleware. Selecting this provider with the script enabled turns on local routing. Turning the switch off keeps the code and skips execution. Save to apply changes.
proxyScript.runtime: Requires local Node.js 24+; supports node: built-ins. Scripts run with your local user permissions. next(request) uses CC Switch's network proxy settings.
